title: Warm German Pretzel Wrap
description: A twist on the classic German pretzel, this recipe wraps the warm dough around a filling of melted cheese and savory meats.
instructions: Roll out the warm pretzel dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread 1/4 cup of the shredded cheese evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top the cheese with sliced ham and salami.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese over the meats.
Add a sprinkle of onion on top of the cheese.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a tight seal.
Brush the top of the dough with melted butter.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes before slicing.
